items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I think I heard him play one time. I was told it was Eshiel, played very fine clarinet.

ctx.x: Happy Shilling. Happy Shilling. Told about a clarinetist used to play with them, Eshiel Baque. Eshiel. And he might have been part colored or something, but anyway, he was very light. I've heard lots about him.
I wonder if you ever heard of that. In fact, I think I heard him play one time. I was told it was Eshiel, played very fine clarinet.
I never got to hear him. I think he-
